title: Sindh Government Land Cancellation of Allotments Conversions and Exchanges Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Government Land Cancellation of Allotments Conversions and Exchanges Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
SINDH GOVERNMENT
LAND (CANCELLATION OF ALLOTMENTS, CONVERSIONS AND EXCHANGES) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Government Land
(Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th October, 2002]
No. S.Legis.1(41)/2002,
26-10-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Government Land
(Cancellation of Allotment, Conversions and Exchanges) (Amendment) Ordinance,
2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall always be deemed to have taken effect on and from 3rd January,
2001.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Government Land Cancellation of Allotments Conversions and Exchanges Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of Ordinance III of 2001

ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
SINDH GOVERNMENT
LAND (CANCELLATION OF ALLOTMENTS, CONVERSIONS AND EXCHANGES) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Government Land
(Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th October, 2002]
No. S.Legis.1(41)/2002,
26-10-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Ordinance III of 2001.----(1) In the Sindh Government Land (Cancellation of
Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) Ordinance,. 2001, hereinafter referred
to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, after clause (v), the following new
clause shall be inserted:-
"(v-a) "Government
land" includes the land vesting in Government or an autonomous body
including a development authority established by law.".
